teaser.en: A wild relative of the clove tree whose Digo name carries a feminine prefix.
teaser.sw: Ndugu pori wa mkarafuu ambao jina lake la Kidigo lina kiambishi cha kike.
teaser.dg: Muhi wa weruni wa jamii mwenga na karafuu, ambao dzinare ra Chidigo rinaandza na mwandzo wa 'chichetu'.

summary.en: Nchibandu is a wild Eugenia, a member of the myrtle family that also gives the clove and the water berry. Pakia records only its name, one of a handful of Digo plant names with a 'female' prefix.
summary.sw: Nchibandu ni Eugenia pori, mwanachama wa familia ya mihadasi, ambayo pia hutupa karafuu na *water berry*. Pakia anaripoti jina lake tu, mojawapo ya majina machache ya mimea ya Kidigo yenye kiambishi cha 'kike'.
summary.dg: *Nchibandu* ni *Eugenia* ya weruni, ya jamii ya mzambarau (*myrtle*), jamii ambayo piya ina karafuu na *water berry*. Pakia kaandika chitu chanjina kuriko dzinare, ambaro ni mwenga wa madzina machache ga mimea ga Chidigo genye mwandzo wa 'chichetu'.

about.en:
*Nchibandu* is a species of *Eugenia*, a large genus of the myrtle family. The *Eugenia* of the East African coast are evergreen shrubs and small trees with opposite, glossy, often leathery leaves that smell faintly aromatic when crushed, small white flowers with many stamens, and fleshy berries.

The exact species was not identified.
about.sw:
*Nchibandu* ni spishi ya *Eugenia*, jenasi kubwa ya familia ya mihadasi. *Eugenia* za pwani ya Afrika Mashariki ni vichaka na miti midogo isiyopukutisha majani, yenye majani yanayoelekeana, yanayong'aa, mara nyingi magumu kama ngozi, yenye harufu nzuri hafifu yanapopondwa, maua madogo meupe yenye stameni nyingi, na matunda ya beri yenye nyama.

Spishi yake halisi haikutambuliwa.
about.dg:
*Nchibandu* ni aina ya *Eugenia*, jenasi kulu ya jamii ya mzambarau (*myrtle*). *Eugenia* za pwani ya Afrika Mashariki ni vitsaka na mihi midide yenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ganamera mairi mairi ganalolana, ganang'ala, mara nyinji ni mafu dza chingo, na gachifikitswa ganalavya arufu nono chidide. Maruwa ni madide mereru genye stameni nyinji, na matunda ni madide genye nyama.

Taimanyikana ni aina ipi hasa.

where.en: *Eugenia* species grow in coastal forest, thicket and dune bush on the south coast. Pakia recorded *nchibandu* among the Digo but gives no habitat.
where.sw: Spishi za *Eugenia* huota katika misitu ya pwani, vichaka vizito na vichaka vya matuta ya mchanga katika pwani ya kusini. Pakia aliripoti *nchibandu* miongoni mwa Wadigo lakini hatoi mazingira yake.
where.dg: Aina za *Eugenia* zinamera matsakani ga pwani, vitsakani na weruni phatu pha mtsanga wa pwani, pwani ya kusini. Pakia waandika *nchibandu* kahi ya Adigo, ela kagomba unamera kuphi.

culture.en: Pakia points out that some Digo plant names start with a prefix that, in personal names, marks a woman. *Nchibandu* is one of them, with *nchikoma*, *nchivuri* and *nchidoka*. Digo has no grammatical gender, so the prefix seems to carry a borrowed sense of 'female' rather than a rule of grammar.
culture.sw: Pakia anaonyesha kwamba baadhi ya majina ya mimea ya Kidigo huanza na kiambishi ambacho, katika majina ya watu, huonyesha mwanamke. *Nchibandu* ni mojawapo, pamoja na *nchikoma*, *nchivuri* na *nchidoka*. Kidigo hakina jinsia ya kisarufi, kwa hiyo kiambishi hicho kinaonekana kubeba maana iliyoazimwa ya 'kike' badala ya kanuni ya sarufi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaonyesa kukala madzina ganjina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganaandza na mwandzo ambao, kpwa madzina ga atu, unaonyesa kukala ni mchetu. *Nchibandu* ni mwenga wa madzina higo, phamwenga na *nchikoma*, *nchivuri* na *nchidoka*. Chidigo tachina jinsia ya chisarufi, kpwa hivyo mwandzo uhu unaonekana kuhala mana ya 'chichetu' iriyoaphaswa, sio shariya ya sarufi.

names.en: Pakia records *nchibandu*; the meaning of the name is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchibandu*; maana ya jina haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchibandu*; mana ya dzina hiri taielezwa. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.
